summary: Frontend-only regression at 390x844 found a blocking React Native web red screen on initial load. TypeScript and the local model asset pass, but the current landmark workaround crashes before home renders.

ui_bugs.issue: Expo web red screen: Cannot add property opacity, object is not extensible at Object.assign(styles.landmark, { opacity: 0 })

react_native_issues.issue: StyleSheet.create returns a frozen/non-extensible style object on web; mutating it at module scope crashes the entire app.

action_items: Remove the Object.assign mutation and hide the decorative landmarks through a non-mutating style/property or render condition.
After fixing the red screen, rerun home/calibration no-camera checks and inspect Metro logs for the MediaPipe bundle parse failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Expo logs contain intermittent Web Bundling failed errors for @mediapipe/tasks-vision/vision_bundle.mjs: Invalid call at import(t.toString()), although subsequent entry bundles can succeed.
No fetch, XMLHttpRequest, axios, upload, or video-landmark upload path was found in frontend app/src code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At the public preview URL with 390x844, the app immediately shows Expo LogBox red screen before home. The stack points to app/index.tsx line 65 Object.assign(styles.landmark...). No webcam inference or no-camera calibration behavior could be retested in this iteration.
rca_of_issue: The prior iteration hid decorative landmarks by mutating a StyleSheet.create result. On Expo web that style object is non-extensible, so Object.assign throws during module evaluation and prevents React from mounting. Replace mutation with a separate style object (for example opacity: 0 directly in the StyleSheet definition) or conditionally omit the layer.
